prose: Simon Willison covers Meta's Muse Ember, its smallest model, which Meta says sits on the Artificial Analysis efficiency frontier: no model scores higher for less per task. For short prompts it costs $0.10 per million input and $0.50 output tokens, the same as GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5, though longer prompts cost more. He rendered pelican SVGs at six reasoning levels; the 'high' level failed to return a full image and quality did not track level.
highlights: Priced like Luna and Haiku 5.5 for short prompts
Meta claims the efficiency frontier on Artificial Analysis
Six reasoning levels, pelican test shows uneven results
